Triazaacenaphthylene antibiotics.description: A novel structural class of antibacterial agents, of which gepotidacin is the first-in-class member, that inhibit bacterial DNA replication via a distinct mechanism differing from fluoroquinolones.

Trifluridine.body:
# Trifluridine

Trifluridine (trifluorothymidine, TFT/FTD) is a thymidine-based cytotoxic pyrimidine nucleoside analog and the active antineoplastic component of [trifluridine/tipiracil](../molecule/trifluridine-tipiracil.md) (TAS-102). After phosphorylation by thymidine kinase 1 to its monophosphate (TFT-MP), it covalently binds and inhibits [thymidylate synthase](../molecule/thymidylate-synthase-protein.md) (Ki 0.38 nM); as the triphosphate (TFT-TP) it is incorporated into DNA, producing DNA strand breaks and cell death — the major mechanism of action of TAS-102.

Given alone, trifluridine has poor oral bioavailability because it is rapidly degraded by [thymidine phosphorylase](../molecule/thymidine-phosphorylase-protein.md) to the inactive metabolite FTY; its plasma half-life after injection in patients is under 15 minutes. This degradation is overcome by combining it with [tipiracil](../molecule/tipiracil.md). Trifluridine was originally developed by Heidelberger and colleagues and is also registered (as Viroptic) for ophthalmic herpes simplex virus infection.

## Citations
- [A phase 1 study of the pharmacokinetics of trifluridine and tipiracil (components of TAS-102) vs trifluridine alone](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28111727/) (PMID:28111727)
- [Therapeutic potential of TAS-102 in the treatment of gastrointestinal malignancies](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26557901/) (PMID:26557901)
Trifluridine.description: A thymidine-based cytotoxic pyrimidine nucleoside analog that, after phosphorylation by thymidine kinase 1, inhibits thymidylate synthase and is incorporated into DNA to cause DNA damage; the active antineoplastic component of trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102).

edges.note: a cytotoxic nucleoside-analog antimetabolite with a short plasma half-life typical of this class
cytotoxic component of the trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102) combination, 1:0.5 molar ratio with tipiracil
anticancer activity (as the active component of TAS-102) against fluoropyrimidine-refractory colorectal cancer via thymidylate synthase inhibition and incorporation into DNA
trifluridine monophosphate (TFT-MP) binds covalently to the active site (Tyr146) of thymidylate synthase; potent reversible inhibitor, Ki 0.38 nM

trifluridine is a substrate that is rapidly degraded (phosphorolyzed) by thymidine phosphorylase to the inactive metabolite FTY (5-trifluoromethyluracil / trifluorothymine), causing poor oral bioavailability
single-agent trifluridine (2.5 mg/kg/day) caused severe bone-marrow depression in early clinical trials

Trifluridine/tipiracil.body:
# Trifluridine/tipiracil

Trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102; marketed as Lonsurf) is an orally active antineoplastic fixed-dose combination of the nucleoside analog [trifluridine](../molecule/trifluridine.md) and the thymidine phosphorylase inhibitor [tipiracil](../molecule/tipiracil.md) hydrochloride in a 1:0.5 molar ratio. Tipiracil prevents the rapid first-pass degradation of trifluridine by [thymidine phosphorylase](../molecule/thymidine-phosphorylase-protein.md), thereby markedly increasing oral trifluridine bioavailability so the cytotoxic nucleoside can be used clinically.

Its antitumor activity derives principally from incorporation of trifluridine into DNA (causing DNA damage), with transient inhibition of [thymidylate synthase](../molecule/thymidylate-synthase-protein.md) as a secondary mechanism, and it remains active in 5-fluorouracil-resistant models. In the phase 3 [RECOURSE trial](../study/recourse-trial.md) and the Japanese J003 phase 2 trial it prolonged [overall survival](../biomedicalmeasure/overall-survival.md) over placebo in refractory [metastatic colorectal cancer](../disease/metastatic-colorectal-cancer.md), leading to its approval; the major toxicity is myelosuppression ([neutropenia](../phenotype/neutropenia.md)).

Triglyceride level.body:
# Triglyceride level

Triglyceride level is the fasting plasma concentration of triglycerides, reflecting triglyceride-rich lipoproteins (chylomicrons, VLDL, and their remnants). It is the primary efficacy biomarker for ANGPTL3-targeting therapy in [mixed hyperlipidemia](../disease/mixed-hyperlipidemia.md). In the [ARCHES-2 trial](../study/arches-2-trial.md), the primary end point was percent change in fasting triglycerides at week 24, where [zodasiran](../molecule/zodasiran.md) achieved dose-dependent reductions of -51, -57, and -63 percentage points versus placebo (P<0.001 for all), with 88% of 200-mg recipients reaching triglycerides below 150 mg/dL.

Tulisokibart.body:
# Tulisokibart

Tulisokibart (formerly PRA023; also MK-7240) is a humanized IgG1 kappa monoclonal antibody that binds the membrane-bound and soluble forms of [TL1A](../molecule/tumor-necrosis-factor-like-cytokine-1a-protein.md) (encoded by [TNFSF15](../gene/tnfsf15-gene.md)) with high affinity and specificity. By preventing the interaction of TL1A with its receptor DR3, it suppresses type 1 and type 17 helper T-cell responses, increases regulatory T-cell activity, and decreases profibrotic pathways. In the phase 2 [ARTEMIS-UC trial](../study/artemis-uc-trial.md) for moderately to severely active [ulcerative colitis](../disease/ulcerative-colitis.md), tulisokibart produced [clinical remission](../biomedicalmeasure/clinical-remission.md) in 26% of patients versus 1% with placebo at week 12 (difference 25 percentage points, P<0.001). Its safety profile was similar to placebo.

## Citations

Tumor necrosis factor-like cytokine 1A (.body:
# Tumor necrosis factor-like cytokine 1A (protein)

Tumor necrosis factor-like cytokine 1A (TL1A), encoded by [TNFSF15](../gene/tnfsf15-gene.md), is a TNF-superfamily cytokine expressed by endothelial cells under normal physiological conditions and at high concentrations by immune cells during inflammation. TL1A and its receptor [DR3](../molecule/death-domain-receptor-3-protein.md) are substantially up-regulated in inflamed intestinal tissues, where TL1A-DR3 signaling promotes type 1 and type 17 helper T-cell responses, suppresses regulatory T-cell activity, and drives profibrotic pathways in [inflammatory bowel disease](../disease/inflammatory-bowel-disease.md). It is the target of [tulisokibart](../molecule/tulisokibart.md), evaluated for [ulcerative colitis](../disease/ulcerative-colitis.md) in the [ARTEMIS-UC trial](../study/artemis-uc-trial.md).

Tyrosine kinase inhibitors.body:
# Tyrosine kinase inhibitors

Tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs) are small molecules that inhibit the catalytic activity of tyrosine kinases, blocking receptor phosphorylation and downstream signaling. [Infigratinib](../molecule/infigratinib.md) is an orally bioavailable, FGFR1-3 selective tyrosine kinase inhibitor in this class; in [achondroplasia](../disease/achondroplasia.md) it inhibits phosphorylation of [FGFR3](../molecule/fibroblast-growth-factor-receptor-3-protein.md) to attenuate the receptor's overactive downstream signaling.

Tyrosine kinase inhibitors.description: A class of small molecules that inhibit the catalytic (kinase) activity of tyrosine kinases, blocking phosphorylation and downstream signaling; includes receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors such as the FGFR-selective inhibitor infigratinib.

UNITY study.body:
# UNITY study

UNITY (NCT03842189) was an international, open-label, single-group, phase 2 study evaluating weekly IV [nipocalimab](../molecule/nipocalimab.md) (30 or 45 mg/kg of baseline or current body weight, per protocol amendments) from 14 to 35 weeks gestation in 13 pregnant participants (14 pregnancies) at high risk for recurrent early-onset severe [hemolytic disease of the fetus and newborn](../disease/hemolytic-disease-of-the-fetus-and-newborn.md). [Live birth](../biomedicalmeasure/live-birth-rate.md) at 32 weeks gestation or later without an intrauterine transfusion (the primary endpoint) occurred in 7 of 13 pregnancies (54%; 95% CI 25-81; P<0.001 vs the 10% margin over a 0% historical benchmark). No fetal hydrops occurred and maternal IgG and alloantibody titers fell during treatment. Funded by Janssen Research and Development.

## Citations
- [Nipocalimab in Early-Onset Severe Hemolytic Disease of the Fetus and Newborn](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39115062/) (PMID:39115062)

Ulcerative colitis.body:
# Ulcerative colitis

Ulcerative colitis (UC) is a chronic inflammatory gastrointestinal disorder and a subtype of [inflammatory bowel disease](../disease/inflammatory-bowel-disease.md), characterized by abdominal cramping, diarrhea, and rectal bleeding. Moderately to severely active disease often remains refractory to conventional and advanced therapies (TNF antagonists, vedolizumab, ustekinumab, JAK inhibitors, ozanimod). The [ARTEMIS-UC trial](../study/artemis-uc-trial.md) demonstrated that [tulisokibart](../molecule/tulisokibart.md), an anti-TL1A antibody, induced [clinical remission](../biomedicalmeasure/clinical-remission.md) more effectively than placebo, establishing TL1A blockade as a new mechanism of action.

## Citations

Uncomplicated urinary tract infection.body:
# Uncomplicated urinary tract infection

Uncomplicated urinary tract infection (uUTI, acute cystitis) is a urinary tract infection without anatomical or functional abnormalities or complicating disease, affecting an estimated 50-60% of adult women in their lifetime. It is most commonly caused by [Escherichia coli](../organism/escherichia-coli.md) and is increasingly difficult to treat owing to antimicrobial resistance. [Gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) was evaluated against [nitrofurantoin](../molecule/nitrofurantoin.md) for this indication in the [EAGLE-2](../study/eagle-2-trial.md) and [EAGLE-3](../study/eagle-3-trial.md) phase 3 trials.

Uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhoea.body:
# Uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhoea

Uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhoea is a sexually transmitted infection of the urogenital tract caused by [Neisseria gonorrhoeae](../organism/neisseria-gonorrhoeae.md). Untreated infection can lead to pelvic inflammatory disease, ectopic pregnancy, and infertility. With multidrug resistance threatening the remaining first-line options (ceftriaxone +/- azithromycin), [gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) is in development as a novel oral treatment, dosed as two 3000 mg oral doses 10-12 h apart.

## Citations

Unemo 2024 — in silico gepotidacin targe.body:
# Unemo 2024 — in silico gepotidacin target mining

This study (J Antimicrob Chemother 2024) mined gyrA and parC alleles from 33,213 publicly available global [Neisseria gonorrhoeae](../organism/neisseria-gonorrhoeae.md) genomes and determined [gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) MICs in 22 clinical isolates with GyrA A92 alterations combined with other GyrA/ParC substitutions. It found GyrA A92 highly conserved (alterations 0.24%, no A92T), ParC D86 alterations common (10.6%), and no combination causing gepotidacin resistance, with AlphaFold-based molecular modelling of the binding site.

## Citations
- [In silico gepotidacin target mining among 33 213 global Neisseria gonorrhoeae genomes from 1928 to 2023 combined with gepotidacin MIC testing of 22 gonococcal isolates with different GyrA and ParC substitutions](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39004438/) (PMID:39004438)

Upper-to-lower body segment ratio.body:
# Upper-to-lower body segment ratio

The upper-to-lower body segment ratio is an anthropometric measure of body proportionality — the ratio of the head-and-trunk (upper) segment to the legs (lower) segment — calculated from sitting and standing height as sitting height / (standing height - sitting height). It is elevated in [achondroplasia](../disease/achondroplasia.md) (mean ~2.0 from age 4) compared with ~1.0 in average stature, reflecting [disproportionate short stature](../phenotype/disproportionate-short-stature.md) with limb shortening exceeding truncal shortening.

In the [PROPEL 2 trial](../study/propel-2-trial.md), once-daily [infigratinib](../molecule/infigratinib.md) at 0.25 mg/kg/day (cohort 5) decreased the mean ratio from 2.02 at baseline to 1.88 at 18 months (mean change -0.12; 95% CI -0.18 to -0.06), indicating improved body proportions.

Urinary tract infection.body:
# Urinary tract infection

Urinary tract infection (UTI) was among the most common treatment-emergent adverse events with [inebilizumab](../molecule/inebilizumab.md): 11% (vs 9% placebo) in the N-MOmentum randomized controlled period and 22.2% in the combined RCP/open-label analysis, and 12% (8/68) in the [MITIGATE trial](../study/mitigate-trial.md). Consistent with B-cell depletion, infection risk is a recognized safety consideration for inebilizumab.

VM-PATHI score.body:
# VM-PATHI score

The VM-PATHI (Vestibular Migraine Patient Assessment Tool and Handicap Inventory) is a validated, disease-specific patient-reported outcome measure for [vestibular migraine](../disease/vestibular-migraine.md), comprising 25 items scored from 0 to 100. As the primary endpoint of the [INVESTMENT trial](../study/investment-trial.md), VM-PATHI dropped 14.8 points on [galcanezumab](../molecule/galcanezumab.md) versus 5.1 points on placebo (difference -9.6; p=0.044 by one-tailed t-test; Cohen's d=0.56).

Vertigo.body:
# Vertigo

Vertigo is a sensation of spinning or self-motion and is the defining recurrent vestibular symptom of [vestibular migraine](../disease/vestibular-migraine.md), which is its most common cause. In the [Russo 2023 cohort](../study/russo-2023-anti-cgrp-mabs-for-vestibular-migraine.md), 90% of patients achieved at least a 50% reduction in monthly vertigo/dizziness days on anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies.

Vestibular migraine.body:
# Vestibular migraine

Vestibular migraine (VM) is one of the most common vestibular disorders and the most common cause of recurrent vertigo, affecting roughly 2.7% of adults. Diagnostic criteria are available from the Barany Society and the ICHD-III; clinical features include [vertigo](../phenotype/vertigo.md), [dizziness](../phenotype/dizziness.md), [headache](../phenotype/headache.md), motion sensitivity, photophobia, phonophobia, aural pressure, tinnitus, and brain fog.

Although its pathophysiology is incompletely understood, accumulating evidence — including the efficacy of CGRP blockade — supports the view that VM is a form of [migraine](../disease/migraine.md) whose mechanism involves [CGRP](../molecule/calcitonin-gene-related-peptide-protein.md). It was historically an unmet need with no placebo-controlled trial evidence until [anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies](../molecularclass/anti-cgrp-monoclonal-antibodies.md) were studied in the [Russo 2023 cohort](../study/russo-2023-anti-cgrp-mabs-for-vestibular-migraine.md) and the [INVESTMENT trial](../study/investment-trial.md).

## Citations

Vestibular system.body:
# Vestibular system

The vestibular system comprises the sensory organs of the inner ear and their central pathways (vestibular nuclei, cerebellum, and connected cortical regions) that mediate balance and spatial orientation. Both [CGRP](../molecule/calcitonin-gene-related-peptide-protein.md) and the [CGRP receptor](../molecule/cgrp-receptor-protein.md) are expressed within cochlear and vestibular organs, providing an anatomical basis for CGRP's involvement in [vestibular migraine](../disease/vestibular-migraine.md).

Vorasidenib.body:
# Vorasidenib

Vorasidenib (AG-881) is an oral, brain-penetrant dual inhibitor of mutant [IDH1](../gene/idh1-gene.md)/IDH2 that suppresses production of the oncometabolite 2-hydroxyglutarate. In a phase 3 trial of 340 patients with IDH-mutant [glioma](../disease/glioma.md), vorasidenib significantly improved progression-free survival; an earlier phase 1 study of AG-120/AG-881 showed decreased 2-hydroxyglutarate in resected tumors with reduced tumor-cell proliferation and increased immune-cell activation.

## Citations

# Wagenlehner 2024 — EAGLE-2 and EAGLE-3 phase 3 results

This Lancet article (2024) reports the primary efficacy and safety results of the [EAGLE-2](../study/eagle-2-trial.md) and [EAGLE-3](../study/eagle-3-trial.md) phase 3, randomised, double-blind, double-dummy, non-inferiority trials of oral [gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) versus [nitrofurantoin](../molecule/nitrofurantoin.md) for [uncomplicated urinary tract infection](../disease/uncomplicated-urinary-tract-infection.md) in 3136 randomly assigned patients across 219 centres. Gepotidacin was non-inferior in both studies and superior in EAGLE-3.

Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia.body:
# Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia

Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) is an [IgG](../molecule/immunoglobulin-g.md) autoantibody-mediated disease in which warm-reactive anti-erythrocyte autoantibodies cause hemolysis. It is cited among the autoantibody-mediated diseases (alongside myasthenia gravis, rheumatoid arthritis and Sjögren's disease) for which [nipocalimab](../molecule/nipocalimab.md) and FcRn blockade are under evaluation.

# Watkins 2023 — gepotidacin review for uUTI and gonorrhoea

This review (J Antimicrob Chemother 2023) summarises the development of [gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) — its mechanism of action, antibacterial spectrum (including MIC data), PK/PD properties, and phase I/II/III clinical trials — and discusses its potential clinical role for [uncomplicated urinary tract infection](../disease/uncomplicated-urinary-tract-infection.md) and [uncomplicated urogenital gonorrhoea](../disease/uncomplicated-urogenital-gonorrhoea.md). If approved, gepotidacin would be the first new oral antibiotic for UTIs in more than 20 years.

Xalnesiran.body:
# Xalnesiran

Xalnesiran (RG6346) is an investigational N-acetyl-D-galactosamine (GalNAc)-conjugated synthetic double-stranded small interfering RNA that targets the S conserved region of the [hepatitis B virus](../organism/hepatitis-b-virus.md) genome, silencing multiple HBV transcripts to reduce hepatitis B surface antigen. It is developed as the backbone of finite-duration functional-cure regimens for [chronic hepatitis B](../disease/chronic-hepatitis-b.md). In the [Piranga trial](../study/piranga-trial.md), 48 weeks of xalnesiran plus an immunomodulator produced substantial [HBsAg](../biomedicalmeasure/hepatitis-b-surface-antigen-level.md) loss — 23% with [peginterferon alfa-2a](../molecule/peginterferon-alfa-2a.md) and 12% with [ruzotolimod](../molecule/ruzotolimod.md) at 24 weeks after end of treatment — whereas xalnesiran monotherapy produced HBsAg loss in only 3-7%, indicating that an immunomodulator is essential for HBsAg loss.

## Citations
- [Xalnesiran with or without an Immunomodulator in Chronic Hepatitis B](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39774313/) (PMID:39774313)

Yang 2024 — population PK/PD modeling of.body:
# Yang 2024 — population PK/PD modeling of axatilimab

This is the first report describing a semimechanistic population pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic (PK/PD) model of [axatilimab](../molecule/axatilimab.md), built from four pooled clinical studies (healthy participants, solid tumors, and cGVHD) totaling 325 participants including 278 with [chronic graft-versus-host disease](../disease/chronic-graft-versus-host-disease.md). The model used a two-compartment PK structure with target-mediated drug disposition and turnover PD models for CSF-1, nonclassical CD14+/CD16++ monocytic cells (NCMCs), AST, and CPK, reflecting competitive binding of axatilimab and CSF-1 to [CSF-1R](../molecule/colony-stimulating-factor-1-receptor-protein.md). Body weight was the only covariate affecting steady-state axatilimab exposure by more than 20%. The results informed the axatilimab dosing strategy in cGVHD.

## Citations
- [Semimechanistic Population PK/PD Modeling of Axatilimab in Healthy Participants and Patients With Solid Tumors or Chronic Graft-Versus-Host Disease](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39704205/) (PMID:39704205)

Zenocutuzumab.body:
# Zenocutuzumab

Zenocutuzumab (Zeno; MCLA-128) is a bispecific, humanized, glycoengineered IgG1 monoclonal antibody and a member of the [bispecific antibodies](../molecularclass/bispecific-antibodies.md) class. Its two Fab arms bind the extracellular domains of [HER2](../molecule/receptor-tyrosine-protein-kinase-erbb-2-protein.md) and [HER3](../molecule/receptor-tyrosine-protein-kinase-erbb-3-protein.md). Through a "Dock & Block" mechanism, the HER2 arm docks onto the more abundant HER2 to create a high local antibody concentration, positioning the HER3 arm to block [NRG1](../molecule/neuregulin-1-protein.md) (and NRG1 fusion protein) binding to HER3 and to prevent HER2-HER3 heterodimerization and downstream [HER2-HER3 / PI3K-AKT signaling](../biologicalpathway/her2-her3-pi3k-akt-signaling.md). Afucosylation of the Fc enhances antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.

Preclinically, Zeno inhibited growth of [NRG1 fusion-positive](../disease/nrg1-fusion-positive-cancer.md) lung, breast, pancreatic and ovarian cancer cells and PDX models at low/subnanomolar concentrations. In three patients treated on single-patient protocols at 750 mg IV every 2 weeks, Zeno produced durable RECIST partial responses and disease control in [NRG1-fusion PDAC](../disease/nrg1-fusion-pancreatic-ductal-adenocarcinoma.md) and [NRG1-fusion NSCLC](../disease/nrg1-fusion-non-small-cell-lung-cancer.md), with treatment-related diarrhoea (all grade 1-2) in only 20% of patients. It is being evaluated in the global phase I/II [eNRGy trial](../study/enrgy-trial.md).

## Citations
- [Zenocutuzumab, a HER2xHER3 Bispecific Antibody, Is Effective Therapy for Tumors Driven by NRG1 Gene Rearrangements](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/35135829/) (PMID:35135829)
- [The phase I/II eNRGy trial: Zenocutuzumab in patients with cancers harboring NRG1 gene fusions](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38348690/) (PMID:38348690)

Zodasiran.body:
# Zodasiran

Zodasiran (ARO-ANG3; Arrowhead Pharmaceuticals) is an investigational [small interfering RNA](../molecularclass/small-interfering-rna-therapeutics.md) that disrupts hepatic expression of [ANGPTL3](../gene/angptl3-gene.md) by degrading its messenger RNA, inhibiting synthesis and secretion of [angiopoietin-like 3](../molecule/angiopoietin-like-3-protein.md). In the phase 2b [ARCHES-2 trial](../study/arches-2-trial.md) for [mixed hyperlipidemia](../disease/mixed-hyperlipidemia.md), zodasiran produced dose-dependent reductions in [triglycerides](../biomedicalmeasure/triglyceride-level.md) (-63 percentage points vs placebo at week 24 with 200 mg, P<0.001), ANGPTL3 (-74 points), LDL cholesterol (-20 points), non-HDL cholesterol (-36 points), and apolipoprotein B (-22 points). A transient increase in glycated hemoglobin was observed in patients with preexisting diabetes at the highest dose.

Zotiraciclib.body:
# Zotiraciclib

Zotiraciclib (TG02) is a brain-penetrant oral multi-cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor that targets CDK-1, -2, -5, -7 and -9 (with [CDK-9](../molecule/cyclin-dependent-kinase-9-protein.md) as its main target) along with JAK2, FLT3 and other tyrosine kinases at nanomolar concentrations. CDK-9 inhibition blocks RNA polymerase II phosphorylation and depletes short-lived survival proteins such as [c-MYC](../molecule/myc-proto-oncogene-protein.md) and [MCL-1](../molecule/induced-myeloid-leukemia-cell-differentiation-protein-mcl-1-protein.md), inducing apoptosis in [glioblastoma](../disease/glioblastoma.md) cells.

In the phase Ib [EORTC 1608 STEAM trial](../study/eortc-1608-steam-trial.md), single-agent zotiraciclib at 150 mg twice weekly in recurrent glioblastoma (group C) showed insufficient activity: PFS-6 was 6.7% and median overall survival was 7.1 months, with toxicity (myelosuppression, hepatotoxicity, gastrointestinal effects) overlapping that of alkylating agents. A comprehensive glioma review highlights its blood-brain-barrier penetration and preclinical synergy with [temozolomide](../molecule/temozolomide.md).

## Citations

eNRGy trial.body:
# eNRGy trial

The eNRGy trial (NCT02912949) is a global, open-label, multicenter phase I/II trial sponsored by Merus NV evaluating [zenocutuzumab](../molecule/zenocutuzumab.md) (Zeno) in patients with [NRG1 fusion-positive cancer](../disease/nrg1-fusion-positive-cancer.md). Part 1 (dose escalation) is complete; Part 2 is dose expansion across indication cohorts in [NRG1-fusion NSCLC](../disease/nrg1-fusion-non-small-cell-lung-cancer.md), [NRG1-fusion PDAC](../disease/nrg1-fusion-pancreatic-ductal-adenocarcinoma.md), and a basket of other NRG1+ solid tumors. Patients receive Zeno 750 mg IV once every 2 weeks over 4-week cycles, with eligibility requiring a documented [NRG1 gene fusion](../variant/nrg1-gene-fusion.md) detected by molecular assays (RNA-based testing preferred).

The primary endpoint is [objective response rate](../biomedicalmeasure/objective-response-rate.md) (magnitude of antitumor activity per RECIST v1.1) and the key secondary endpoint is [duration of response](../biomedicalmeasure/duration-of-response.md). The overall planned sample size was increased to a maximum of 250 patients to support regulatory submission. This publication describes the rationale and design only; no efficacy results are reported.

## Citations

fAUC/MIC ratio.body:
# fAUC/MIC ratio

The fAUC/MIC ratio (ratio of the area under the free-drug plasma concentration-time curve over 24 h to the MIC) is the pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic index most closely associated with [gepotidacin](../molecule/gepotidacin.md) efficacy. In the phase 2 gonorrhoea study, microbiological success was 100% when fAUC/MIC was >=48 and all three urogenital failures had fAUC/MIC <=24. An efficacy target of 40 and a hollow-fibre-derived resistance-suppression target of 46 were used in population PK modelling to select the phase III dose (two 3000 mg doses), achieving >=97.5% and >=91.7% probability of target attainment for [N. gonorrhoeae](../organism/neisseria-gonorrhoeae.md) MICs <=1 ug/mL.

## Citations
